review_description: The whole process was made very easy. The quoting process was straight forward and all my queries were addressed in an easy to understand explaination.Skyward Energy did a quote via email but also attended for an onsite visit to address my queries.Both Daniel and his apprentice were polite, tidy and on time.The grid connection was organised and after installation, the App was setup.

Quote was quick, communication was fast and all my questions were answered.Professional, polite and punctual on the day, fast and neat installation.Great customer service, gave a full demo on how things worked, tidied up afterwards.Highly recommend Skyward Energy.

Contact was very prompt after enquiry with a lot of extra useful information. Travelled out or Perth to install the system, very prompt and installation was quite quick. Explained and sent copies of all applications required. Great job!!

Daniel from Skyward Energy was excellent with the installation. After being recommended by a friend, he quoted me a very competitive price with a full rundown of the costs, what would be installed and where it would go. They arrived on time and completed the panels and inverter installation in 3 hours. They were professional and didn’t leave any mess afterwards. Daniel showed me how the inverter works and set up the energy monitoring app on my phone for me. I would have no problem recommending their services to others and would even use them again in the future if required.

Great Installation by these guys.The guys were punctual,friendly and did not take long to remove my old system and install the new one.They showed me how things worked and explained about connecting to the solar.web app.
All went as expected! Definitely reccomend the isntallers. Nice, quick and easy
